title: KAFKA-21317: Continue timestamp search across eligible log segments
body:
After the log start offset advances into a segment, its cached largest timestamp can come from a record below the new start offset. The per-segment timestamp lookup correctly returns empty when no retained record matches, but `UnifiedLog` currently returns that empty result without checking later segments that may contain a valid match.

Continue searching eligible segments until a lookup returns a result. Preserve the one-time segment snapshot and use in-memory base offsets to skip obsolete segments without reading segment tails. Add a file-backed, two-segment regression with non-monotonic timestamps and a log start offset inside the first segment.

Jira: https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-21317
